name: Ranger
body:
Alignment: Any

Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s ranger class levels gains the ranger‘s favored enemy class feature. When determining the how many favored enemies and the bonuses of the apprentice’s favored enemy, the apprentice’s effective ranger level is equal to half his apprentice level (minimum 1). The apprentice must select one of his mentor’s favored enemies with each of his favored enemies. When the apprentice reaches 5th and 10th effective ranger level, the +2 bonus to a favored enemy does not need to match his mentor’s choice.

Advanced Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s ranger class levels and chooses ranger for their advanced mentorship ability for the day gains the ranger‘s combat style. The apprentice must select his mentor’s combat style. The apprentice gains a bonus feat available to 2nd level ranger’s of his mentor’s style even if he does not have the normal prerequisites. This feat does not need to be the bonus combat style feat chosen by his mentor. At 9th level the apprentice gains a bonus combat style feat available to 6th level ranger’s of his mentor’s style. At 13th level the apprentice gains a bonus combat style feat available to 10th level ranger’s of his mentor’s style. At 17th level the apprentice gains a bonus combat style feat available to 14th level ranger’s of his mentor’s style.

Cooperation Power

Key ability: Strength or Dexterity

Apprentices who study a mentor’s ranger class levels and chooses ranger for their cooperation power may spend a cooperation point as a standard action to grant himself or an ally the ranger‘s favored terrain class feature for the next hour. The chosen terrain must be one selected by the apprentice’s mentor and the skill and initiative bonus never increases past +2.
